summary: Caledonia Mining Corp Plc filed a Form 6-K on July 8, 2026, reporting a notification from BlackRock Inc. that it crossed a threshold, now holding 6.14% voting rights (5.20% direct shares, 0.94% via financial instruments). The filing is a routine major holdings notification under AIM Rules, not a special situation. No transaction, board recommendation, or structural changes are involved. As a passive regulatory disclosure, there is no actionable event for investors.
